stories.statement: As a member, I want my membership to start once my payment is confirmed so that I get exactly what I paid for.

stories.summary: Failed or abandoned payment creates no membership
stories.statement: As a member, I want to be told when my payment did not go through and try again so that I do not think I am a member when I am not.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a new member whose card is declined, When Razorpay reports failure, Then the system shows that the payment did not go through, creates no membership and keeps the sign-up as unpaid.

Given an unpaid sign-up, When the dashboard counts active members, Then this member is not counted (per A-025, PD-016).
Given a renewal whose payment failed, When the member opens their page, Then the expiry date is unchanged.
